messages:
hannah: rough idea: "autopilot" rollout mode for flags. system ramps exposure automatically until a telemetry gate fails, then either decays or routes to a fallback. want to capture API + console + safe defaults discussion.
mike: sounds useful. quick q: what gates do we trust? latency, errors, model-quality drift?
sudeep: we'll need a combo: absolute thresholds (p95 > X) + relative change (3x baseline) plus a min_volume. and for model-quality, a similarity/drift score from evals.
hannah: agree. importantly we must constrain ramp speed and overall cost impact. propose `ramp_per_min` and `max_exposure` fields. also a `budget_cap` so autopilot never consumes more than N GPU-minutes/hour.
mike: API-wise, owners will want to opt into dry-run steps (shadow for 1% before full ramp). plus ability to pin fallback target: `fallback_action: route_to:stable | pause | decay`.
sudeep: implement as a state machine: START -> RAMP(step) -> MONITOR(window) -> DECAY or STABLE. include cooldown windows to avoid oscillation.
rollout-bot: rollout-bot: scheduled autopilot-test job for staging @ 5867001234 (no real traffic).
console: UX: show a single "autopilot status" card with current exposure, last gate evaluation (with reason), and a visible "pause" + "force fallback" button. include link to preview-sim results.
qa: we should inject synthetic probes for critical routes so autopilot can detect correctness regressions that don't change latency. small set of canonical prompts + expected signals.
hannah: API sketch (high level): POST /v1/flags/{id}/autopilot -> {signals: [...], min_volume: 100, ramp_per_min: 10, max_exposure: 80, fallback_action: "route_to:stable-v2", budget_cap: "gpu_ms:2000/h", scope: "per-tenant|global", auto_unpause_after: "2h", dry_run_pct: 1, owners: [..], audit_link: "..."}
mike: need baseline calc job: compute median metrics over previous N days and store a baseline id referenced by autopilot config. that avoids noisy baselines.
sudeep: edge cases: multi-tenant flags must run autopilot per-cohort. otherwise one noisy tenant will block rollout for everyone. and tenant privacy: don't expose tenant ids in console unless user has access.
hannah: good call. we'll support `scope: per-tenant` and `cohorting` config. also require explicit owner approval if scope=global and max_exposure>10%.
console: add a small notice: "autopilot will never exceed configured budget cap." make the pause button require a short justification.
qa: add an automated postmortem entry to telemetry ledger whenever autopilot decays a rollout (include snapshot + rule id).
hannah: i'll draft an RFC + YAML example and include a small state-machine diagram and a sample audit record. ping me for reviews.
mike: i'll take API auth + quota enforcement.
sudeep: i'll do monitor/decay algo and baseline job.
rollout-bot: created test alert group "autopilot-firing-staging" (no pages)
hannah: thanks all — will post RFC here later today. :white_check_mark:
